product_niche: Hand-carved fine jewellery and engagement rings
product_or_collection: Wild Iris engagement ring (rose cut diamond three stone and lab-grown diamond versions); alternate metals available on pre-order
personalized_store_observation: All pieces are hand crafted in the Toronto studio; the Wild Iris ring is offered with rose cut diamonds and as a lab-grown diamond version, and the FAQ invites customers to email about alternate metals on pre-order pieces.
inventory_order_automation_opportunity: Auto-tag pre-order and custom-metal orders, push them to a studio job sheet (stone, metal, size) and send customers stage-by-stage progress updates.
opportunity_reasoning: Handmade pre-order and custom-metal requests mean each order carries unique production details that must reach the bench and be communicated back to customers.
personalized_email_body:
Hi Laurie Fleming Jewellery team,

I was looking at the Wild Iris engagement ring, which you offer with rose cut diamonds and as a lab-grown diamond version, and noticed customers can ask about alternate metals on pre-order pieces. Every piece is hand crafted in your Toronto studio, so each order carries its own details.

I build Shopify automation systems that make inventory updates, order processing and supplier notifications simpler. One idea: when a pre-order or custom-metal order comes in, it is automatically tagged and added to a studio job sheet with stone type, metal and ring size, and the customer gets a progress update at each stage.

Would something like that fit how your studio tracks bench work?

Best regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
Shopify Automation & Integration Specialist

product_niche: Full-grain leather belts, wallets and bags made in Canada
product_or_collection: The Purpose Belt, sizes 30-46 in brown and black (Brown/34 and Brown/36 shown out of stock); Long Haul belt in Black, Brown, Cognac
personalized_store_observation: Belts are made in Canada (Concord, Ontario contact) and The Purpose Belt runs sizes 30-46 in two colours, with some sizes showing out of stock; other models each have their own colour range.
inventory_order_automation_opportunity: Low-stock thresholds per belt size/colour that trigger restock notes to production plus back-in-stock alerts to waiting customers.
opportunity_reasoning: Many size x colour variants across several belt models, with visible out-of-stock sizes, make per-variant stock monitoring valuable.
personalized_email_body:
Hi NAB Leather team,

I noticed The Purpose Belt comes in sizes 30 to 46 in both brown and black, and a couple of sizes, Brown 34 and 36, were showing as out of stock. With the Long Haul, Crest and Brixton belts each in their own colour range, there are many combinations to watch before the holidays.

I set up Shopify automations that help stores simplify inventory updates, order processing and supplier notifications. For example, when any belt size drops below a set level, a restock note could go straight to your production team, and waiting customers could get an alert once it is back.

Which belt sizes tend to sell out first for you?

Best regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
Shopify Automation & Integration Specialist
